adjudication.rationale: In `packages/features/bookings/lib/handleNewBooking.ts`, `loadUsers` was changed to a `try/catch` that, for any error not already an `HttpError` or `Prisma.PrismaClientKnownRequestError`, throws a new `HttpError({ statusCode: 500, message: "Unable to load users" })`. This rewrap (a) drops the original error message/stack context and (b) does not log the caught error anywhere in the shown code path, matching the finding. This is primarily an observability/debuggability concern rather than a clearly user-facing correctness defect.
